title: EndpointSlices become the default endpoint source — manifest installs need the discovery.k8s.io RBAC, and the old Endpoints path is opt-out

detection.reason: the controller Deployment's container args and command (the controller parses every os.Args flag and has no config file; the chart renders its values into args) — an unset --enable-endpoint-slices takes the new default (EndpointSlices)

quote: **Change**: EndpointSlices enabled by default (better performance and old endpoint api is on deprecation path: https://kubernetes.io/blog/2025/04/24/endpoints-deprecation/)
remediation: If the controller was installed from a hand-maintained manifest, grant list/watch on endpointslices.discovery.k8s.io before upgrading (the chart's ClusterRole already has it) — without it IP-target registration finds no endpoints and target groups drain. To keep the Endpoints API pass --enable-endpoint-slices=false.
verifyCommand: kubectl get deploy -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.template.spec.containers[]?.image? // "" | test("aws-load-balancer-controller")) | "\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name) \(.spec.template.spec.containers[0].image) args=\(.spec.template.spec.containers[0].args // [] | join(" "))"'  # the controller Deployment, its image tag and every flag it runs with; kubectl auth can-i list endpointslices.discovery.k8s.io --as=system:serviceaccount:kube-system:aws-load-balancer-controller -A  # the can-i must be yes once EndpointSlices are the default
coversNotes: flag default changed: defaultEnableEndpointSlices (false -> true) — defaultEnableEndpointSlices = true

title: IngressClassParams and TargetGroupBinding gain fields in v2.14 — apply the CRDs by hand under Helm

detection.reason: reads the installed CRD's top-level spec field names (crdSpecFields[], agent 0.4.154+); IngressClassParams sslRedirectPort (with loadBalancerName, prefixListsIDs, wafv2Acl*), TargetGroupBinding targetGroupProtocol and LoadBalancerConfiguration shieldConfiguration (with wafV2) are v2.14.0's additions — an older agent writes no field list, which reads not projected, never clean

quote: **Action** : Please apply the latest CRD definitions: `kubectl apply -k "github.com/aws/eks-charts/stable/aws-load-balancer-controller/crds?ref=master"`
remediation: Run kubectl apply -k "github.com/aws/eks-charts/stable/aws-load-balancer-controller/crds?ref=master" and config/crd/gateway/gateway-crds.yaml before upgrading when installed with helm (the crds kustomization applies crds.yaml only, so the gateway.k8s.aws LoadBalancerConfiguration CRD needs the second file).
verifyCommand: kubectl get crd ingressclassparams.elbv2.k8s.aws -o json | jq -r '[.spec.versions[] | select(.served) | .name] as $v | (.spec.versions[] | select(.storage) | .schema.openAPIV3Schema.properties.spec.properties // {} | keys) as $k | "served=\($v | join(",")) spec fields=\($k | join(","))"'  # the installed CRD schema; the 2.14 fields (prefixListsIDs, wafv2AclName) absent from the field list means the CRDs were not re-applied for this release

title: EnhancedDefaultBehavior (off by default) makes the controller REMOVE ALPN / mTLS / capacity settings when their annotation is removed

detection.reason: checked the controller Deployment's --feature-gates for EnhancedDefaultBehavior=true — the opt-in that changes what a removed annotation does

quote: **Impact**: Enable this feature to allow the controller to remove ALPN and mTLS settings by removing the corresponding annotation
remediation: Nothing changes unless the gate is enabled. With it on, deleting alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/mutual-authentication or minimum-load-balancer-capacity now resets the AWS setting instead of leaving it; review Ingresses whose annotations were removed to keep a setting.
verifyCommand: kubectl get deploy -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.template.spec.containers[]?.image? // "" | test("aws-load-balancer-controller")) | "\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name) \(.spec.template.spec.containers[0].image) args=\(.spec.template.spec.containers[0].args // [] | join(" "))"'  # the controller Deployment, its image tag and every flag it runs with

title: v2.14 builds against Gateway API v1.3.0 (docs still point at the v1.2.0 install until 2.17)

detection.reason: checked the Gateway API CRDs' bundle-version annotation — a bundle below v1.3.0 is older than what v2.14 was built against

remediation: Gateway API users: install the v1.3.0 CRDs (standard; experimental for L4 routes) before upgrading, so the fields the controller reads (v1.3 GRPCRoute, ListenerSet precursors) are served.

gate.reason: the Gateway API CRD requirement only bites clusters that run Gateway API routes under this controller — with no route of any kind in the snapshot the controller has nothing to serve

verifyCommand: kubectl get crd -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.group == "gateway.networking.k8s.io") | "\(.metadata.name) bundle=\(.metadata.annotations["gateway.networking.k8s.io/bundle-version"] // "-") served=\([.spec.versions[] | select(.served) | .name] | join(","))"'  # the installed Gateway API CRD bundle version and the API versions each route CRD still serves
